SYMPTOM: Keyboard extension silently fails to launch on fresh simulators. Console shows: `LSStringLocalizer development region en not found in localizations`.
CAUSE: WhisnapKeyboard.appex had no `.lproj` directory — zero localization resources in the bundle.
FIX: Created `WhisnapKeyboard/en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` with `CFBundleDisplayName = "Whisnap";`. Added to Xcode build phases so it's included in the bundle.
SIDE EFFECT: Display name in Settings changed from 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap' to just 'Whisnap'. All Maestro tests updated to match 'Whisnap' instead of 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap'.
PREVENT: All iOS app extensions should have at least a minimal en.lproj.
